verdict: 95 leads at $5.23 each this period; build milestones remain overdue.
narrative: In the last 28 days, Meta delivered all 95 leads at a cost of $5.23 per lead on $497.27 in total spend — the strongest lead volume to date. The past week showed a 115% jump in leads alongside a proportional spend increase, meaning cost efficiency held steady rather than improving. However, delivery paused on September 25–26 due to a gap in ad delivery, not a budget issue, and that is being resolved now. Separately, nine build milestones — covering tracking, search campaigns, and nurture sequences — remain incomplete, and no additional scaling will happen until those are verified closed. Expect a cleaner delivery curve next week as the gap is addressed, and a full milestone review before the Phase 1 close on September 30.
